# Bob | The Friendly Neighborhood Photographer

> Minneapolis-based photographer specializing in natural portraits, lively family sessions, youth & action sports, and full-arc live event coverage across the Twin Cities metro area.

Bob is an experienced photographer based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, serving individuals, families, schools, clubs, teams, and event organizers across the Twin Cities metropolitan area. Known for an easygoing, conversational style ("more chatting, less posing") and reflex-level timing, Bob captures authentic personalities, genuine family chaos, peak athletic motion, and complete event stories. Pricing is transparent, flexible on budget, with fast turnaround times (sneak peeks within 48 hours to a few days; full edited, print-ready gallery delivered shortly after).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Portraits](https://bigbadapps.github.io/BigBadPhotography/#services): Natural, unforced portrait sessions focusing on authentic expressions, relaxed conversation, and personal character.
- [Family Sessions](https://bigbadapps.github.io/BigBadPhotography/#services): Candid, energetic family photography that embraces real family life, playful chaos, kids in motion, and unscripted connection.
- [Sports Photography](https://bigbadapps.github.io/BigBadPhotography/#services): High-speed action sports documentation for park & rec, school, and club teams, capturing peak action, airborne leaps, contact moments, and team celebration.
- [Live Events](https://bigbadapps.github.io/BigBadPhotography/#services): Unobtrusive, start-to-finish event storytelling covering setup, keynote speakers/performers, attendee reactions, and high-energy room peaks.
